post.content:
Today, I’m so proud to open an exciting new chapter for European beauty innovation !

At SEPHORA , we have always been passionate about discovering and nurturing the brands that will define what's next in beauty. That's why we announce the launch of the Sephora Prize for European Beauty Incubation.

Europe is home to an extraordinary wealth of beauty talent, creativity and innovation. Through the Sephora Prize, we aim to support and elevate the next generation of European beauty brands, helping them scale through Sephora's expertise, mentorship, visibility and unique community of beauty lovers.

Our ambition is simple: to help Europe's most promising brands grow beyond their home markets, shine across the region, and reach their full potential.
Applications are now open until July 6, and full details are available on our Sephora website.

I look forward to discovering the visionary founders and brands shaping the future of beauty. 
Together, let's celebrate and champion European beauty excellence !

Can’t wait !

Elodie Barbé Juliette Caloin Sarah Boyd Benoit Ponte Monica Cigognini Sarah Youssouf Joanna Berth Marion Bouchut Arnaud Vanraet

repost.content:
Calling all visionary and innovative European beauty brands! 💄✨

Today, we're launching the Sephora Prize for European Beauty Incubation, a new annual initiative designed to discover, support and scale the most promising brands from across Europe - home to some of the industry's most creative talent and innovative beauty concepts.

At Sephora, curating and elevating brands has always been at the heart of who we are. Every day, our teams help shape beauty trends, build meaningful partnerships with founders, and connect brands with our engaged community of beauty lovers.

Building on our legacy of incubating and growing brands, we're taking our commitment one step further by helping visionary local founders scale their ambitions across Europe.

The Sephora Prize is open to beauty brands across all categories and European markets. The winning brand will benefit from an unprecedented three-year incubation program, including R&D guidance, expert mentoring, extensive visibility, and an exclusive launch across Sephora Europe. Beyond this, additional distinctions may be awarded to other high-potential brands, providing enhanced visibility, mentorship and sponsorship opportunities.

We're excited to meet the founders and brands shaping the future of beauty in Europe!

➡️ Applications are now open until July 6. Learn more and apply on our Sephora website.

Together, we belong to something beautiful.

#SephoraPrize #BrandIncubation #BelongToSomethingBeautiful
